title: Camp introductions
description: Meet the two keepers of Ashen Refuge. Speak to each after accepting this task.

title: Field practice
description: Explore the forest, defeat one hostile and recover one item there. Return to camp to claim your reward.

title: Embers on the Road
description: Edda keeps lamps for the travellers who never returned. Follow the Haunted Forest trail, break the gathering hostiles and search a roadside cache for signs of the lost. Return to Edda at the Ashen Refuge fire.

objectives.label: Follow the forest exit from Ashen Refuge
Open a forest chest, barrel or crate

title: Names Beneath the Ash
description: The forest caches carry the same weathered waykeeper marks as Orren’s ledger. Follow the graveyard exit deeper into the road of the missing. Break its restless guard and search a graveyard cache, then return to Orren in Ashen Refuge.

objectives.label: Take the forest passage to the Forgotten Graveyard
Open a graveyard chest, barrel or crate

title: The Light Below
description: Orren’s marks point beneath the graves. Enter the Ancient Crypt, break its sentries and attune the old beacon in the crypt chamber. Follow graveyard, forest and camp exits home to Edda. The returning light may reveal what still waits below.

objectives.label: Descend through the graveyard crypt passage
